title: ADR-0009 still specifies the status vocabulary as read from backlog/config.yml, and nothing supersedes it
summary: ADR-0009 (Story/Task coupling and reconciliation) says the status vocabulary is read from Backlog config (backlog/config.yml) at lines 50, 138 and 205. The code has not done that unconditionally since the tracker backend became polymorphic: the flow comes from TrackerAdapter.statusFlow(), which Backlog, Quest and Jira each answer differently. No ADR supersedes 0009 on this point (0020 covers tracker version gates, not backend polymorphism), so the architecture of record still describes a Backlog-only design that shipped away. Surfaced while fixing LCLI-503, which was the same staleness in src/core/reconcile.ts's error hints and header prose; that half is fixed. Deliberately not folded into LCLI-503: amending versus superseding an ADR is a decision about the record, not a code change, and the fleet's retirement-scope rule says history is left alone rather than rewritten. Likely shape: a new ADR recording that the status flow is backend-polymorphic, with 0009 marked superseded on that point only.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A decision is recorded on whether ADR-0009 is amended in place or superseded by a new ADR on this point, with the reason
The architecture of record states that the status flow comes from the active backend (TrackerAdapter.statusFlow()), naming all three backend sources
